description: This file defines the ChartDao class, a data access object responsible for retrieving various employee distribution statistics (such as by subunit and location) from the database within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for counting employees, filtering by subunit or location, and returning structured data objects.

classes.name: ChartDao
classes.description: A data access object class for retrieving employee distribution data related to subunit and location, extending the base DAO functionality.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves distribution data of employees grouped by subunit at level 1, returning an array of SubunitCountPair objects.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to any subunit.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Private method that returns the count of employees based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Prepares and returns a query builder wrapper for fetching employee count data filtered by subunit.

methods.name: getTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of active employees (not terminated or purged).

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves employee counts grouped by location, returning an array of LocationEmployeeCount objects.
